title: Insurance policy issuance bundle
description: Policy application, declaration, and certificate evidence through an underwriting-shaped workflow.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: insurance-policy-issuance
  title: Insurance policy issuance bundle
  description: Policy application, declaration, and certificate evidence through an underwriting-shaped workflow.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-fin-04
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/insurance
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [insurance_policy.policy_number, insured_party.named_insured, insurance_organization.carrier_name, coverage.coverage_limits]
      relationshipIds: [covers, issued_by, governs]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/insurance/insurance_policy_application, role: start }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/insurance/policy_declaration_page, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/insurance/certificate_of_insurance, role: supporting }
